title: Choose u
text: Let $$u=arctan(t)$$, so $$du=\frac{dt}{1+t^2}$$. The limits become $$u=0$$ and $$u=\arctan\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The integral of cos(u) is sin(u). Since $$sin\left(\arctan\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$$, the integral is $$\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$$.
